page.layout: One printed page. Top: page number and running head. Main text block of paragraph, then an ornamental woodcut frieze, then a division heading HOMILIA VICESIMASEPTIMA, then a Scripture heading MATTH. 27 and numbered verses in italic below. No marginal notes.

main_text.p: mouere. Dominum igitur precemur vt vbique tum publicis tum priuatis in rebus, sacrosanctum verbum suum in nobis copiose velit habitare. Colos. 3.16. vt dilectionem quam Deo nostro debemus, eiusque erga fideles suos seruos benevolentiam & auxilium opponamus hominum comminationibus, omnium pollicitationibus & illecebris, quibus vel tantillum ab officio quod Deo & proximis debemus dimoveamur: & contra vt sanam & rectam conscientiam retinentes, cognitione Diuinae voluntatis bene instructam regulam vnicam omnium nostrarum cogitationum, dictorum factorumque sequamur.
main_text.head: HOMILIA VICESIMASEPTIMA.
MATTH. 27.
main_text.p: 26. Tunc dimisit eis Barabbam: Iesum autem quum flagellasset, tradidit vt crucifigeretur.
27. Tunc milites praesidis quum abduxissent Iesum in praetorium, congregerunt ad eum vniuersam cohortem.
28. Et quum exuissent eum, circumposuerunt ei chlamydem coccinam.
29. Et coronam e spinis contextam imposuerunt eius

page.notes: Woodcut frieze with grotesque face between the first paragraph and the heading is decoration, not transcribed. Line 29 ends at the page edge; the continuation is not on this page. Some words in the italic verses are doubtful due to print quality, but read as printed.
